entities.name: Abduction of Sisay
entities.description: Event on Jamuraa in 4204 AR in which Captain Sisay was captured and delivered to Volrath's Stronghold.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, abducted by Starke's betrayal.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: Rathi fugitive who betrayed Sisay to protect his daughter Takara.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: Starke's daughter, held hostage by Volrath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar of Rath, who coerced Starke and wanted to bait Gerrard.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Lured away from the Weatherlight by news of Selenia.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Angel whom Crovax loved, imprisoned on Rath.

entities.name: Maraxus of Keld
entities.description: Brutal mercenary in Volrath's employ who pursued Starke.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Volrath's hated rival and chosen bearer of the Legacy.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Recognized the sigil note's ties to Crovax.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: Scattered artifacts Sisay was searching for.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's fortress where Sisay was delivered.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane of shadows ruled by Volrath.

events.summary: Sisay, searching for the Legacy, meets Rathi fugitive Starke, who offers information.
events.quote: Captain Sisay encountered a Rathi fugitive named Starke

events.summary: Starke bargains with Volrath to deliver Sisay in exchange for his daughter Takara's life.
events.quote: In exchange for Takara’s life, he was tasked with delivering Sisay

events.summary: Starke tells Crovax that Selenia is imprisoned on Rath, luring him from the Weatherlight.
events.quote: revealing to him that the angel Selenia

events.summary: Starke betrays Sisay, orchestrating her capture through a planar portal and delivering her to the Stronghold.
events.quote: he orchestrated her capture through a planar portal and delivered her to the Stronghold

events.summary: Sisay's capture baits Gerrard to Rath, fracturing and then reuniting the crew and recruiting Ertai.
